meaning: A misfortune that turns out to be beneficial.
ex: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise, because it pushed her to start her own firm.

meaning: Kind and generous towards others.
ex: The benevolent landlord waived the rent for families who had lost their jobs.

meaning: A lover of books
ex: Every wall of the bibliophile's house is lined with shelves.

meaning: To face a painful or difficult situation with courage.
ex: We will have to bite the bullet and cut the budget this year.

meaning: To ease the awkwardness among people meeting for the first time.
ex: A quick joke helped him break the ice at the meeting.

meaning: To work or study late into the night.
ex: She burnt the midnight oil before the exam.

meaning: Truthful and straightforward, even when it is uncomfortable.
ex: He gave a candid account of what had gone wrong with the project.

w: cost an arm and a leg
meaning: To be extremely expensive.
ex: The repair cost an arm and a leg.

meaning: Showing steady, careful effort in work.
ex: A diligent student, she revised every lesson on the day it was taught.

meaning: Lasting for a very short time.
ex: The ephemeral beauty of the cherry blossom lasts about a week.

meaning: Careful with money and resources; not wasteful.
ex: She led a frugal life and saved half of every salary.

w: hit the nail on the head
meaning: To state exactly what is true or right.
ex: You hit the nail on the head when you said the plan lacked money.

meaning: That which cannot be read
ex: His handwriting was so illegible that nobody could read the note.

meaning: One who hates mankind
ex: After the betrayal he became a misanthrope and avoided everyone.

meaning: No longer in use because something newer has replaced it.
ex: Film cameras became obsolete once digital ones arrived.

meaning: One who knows everything
ex: Nobody is omniscient, so even experts should ask questions.

meaning: Very rarely.
ex: He visits his village once in a blue moon.

meaning: One who loves mankind and helps others
ex: The philanthropist funded three new libraries.

meaning: Not available in enough quantity.
ex: Clean water is scarce in the region during summer.

meaning: One who walks in sleep
ex: The somnambulist woke up in the garden at dawn.

meaning: To reveal a secret.
ex: Someone spilled the beans about the surprise party.

meaning: Using more words than are needed.
ex: His verbose reply took ten minutes to say what a sentence could have said.
